## How is Nicegram different from the official Telegram app?

Nicegram is an unofficial Telegram client for iPhone and iPad, Android and macOS, built on Telegram's open-source apps and connected to Telegram's official servers, so it uses your existing Telegram account, chats and contacts. Unlike the official Telegram app, it adds its own features, such as AI tools and managing several accounts in one place.

## Is Nicegram safe to use?

Nicegram's apps are open source: the iOS, Android and desktop clients are published on GitHub (<https://github.com/nicegram>), so what runs on your device can be checked. Nicegram connects to Telegram's official servers, and your account and chats stay on Telegram. Nicegram's Terms of Use say it does not store or have access to your conversations; what Nicegram itself collects is described in its Privacy Policy (<https://nicegram.me/privacy-policy>).

## Do I need a VPN to use Nicegram?

Nicegram connects to Telegram's official servers, so it works without a VPN wherever Telegram itself works without a VPN. Where Telegram is restricted, Nicegram is restricted the same way.

## How many times has Nicegram been installed?

Nicegram has been installed more than 57 million times on iPhone, iPad and Android.

## Where do I download Nicegram?

Download Nicegram for iPhone and iPad from the App Store (<https://apps.apple.com/us/app/nicegram-ai-for-telegram/id1608870673>), for Android from Google Play (<https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.nicegram>) or as an APK from GitHub (<https://github.com/nicegram/Nicegram-Android/releases/latest/download/app.apk>), and Nicegram Desktop for macOS from the website <https://nicegram.me>. Official Nicegram places: the website <https://nicegram.me>, the channel <https://t.me/nicegramapp>, the community chat <https://t.me/nicegramchat>, and <https://t.me/NicegramNavigation>, which lists all official chats and channels.

## Which iOS or Android version does Nicegram need?

The current Nicegram for iPhone and iPad needs iOS 15 or later, and Nicegram for Android needs Android 7.0 or later.

## How do I install Nicegram on Huawei or a phone without Google Play?

Nicegram on a Huawei phone, HarmonyOS or another phone without Google Play: on the phone, open <https://github.com/nicegram/Nicegram-Android/releases/latest>, tap the app file listed under Assets, open it and allow installing from that source when the phone asks. This works on phones that can install Android apps and run Android 7.0 or later.

## Which Nicegram website and Telegram channels are official?

Official Nicegram places: website <https://nicegram.me>, community chat <https://t.me/nicegramchat>, official Telegram channel <https://t.me/nicegramapp>.

## Are my contacts told when I join, and how do I turn that notice off?

The notice that someone you know has joined is Telegram's own: Telegram can tell people when one of their contacts becomes available on Telegram. Each person chooses whether they get it on their own phone, with the switch called New Contacts or Contact joined Telegram, depending on the phone. The switch changes only your own phone, not what your contacts see.

## Where is the Nicegram assistant button?

Where the Nicegram assistant is: on iPhone and iPad, tap the button with the Nicegram logo at the top right of the chat list; press and hold the same button to show or hide your hidden chats. On Android, tap the Nicegram tab in the bar at the bottom of the screen.

## Why is the Downloads tab missing?

On iPhone and iPad, Downloads is a tab of the search above the chat list, and Nicegram shows it only while your list of recent downloads has files in it. If that list is empty, for example after Clear Download List, the Downloads tab disappears; it comes back as soon as you download a file again. On Android, the Downloads tab is always in search, and the download icon at the top of the chat list appears only while files are downloading or you have downloads you have not opened yet.

## How do I create a group or a channel?

To create a group or channel, go to Chats, tap the pencil icon for a new message, and choose New Group or New Channel. In a group, members talk together; a channel broadcasts your posts to subscribers. Both run on Telegram, so they work the same way in any Telegram app.

## Where is my Telegram link, and how do I set a username?

Your Telegram link is t.me/ followed by your username, and it starts a chat with you. Without a username there is no link. To set one, go to Settings (on iPhone, tap Edit first), tap Username and choose one of at least 5 characters; the screen then shows your link. Anyone can look you up by your username.

## How do I get notifications from a muted channel back?

To find a channel you muted or excluded from notifications, open Settings, then the Notifications section, then Channels. Channels with their own notification setting are listed there; tap one to change it, or tap Delete All Exceptions to reset them all.

## How do I turn off automatic chat translation?

When a chat shows a bar with Show Original at the top, tap it to see the messages as written. To stop it in that chat, tap the button at the right end of the bar and choose Hide or Do Not Translate. To stop it everywhere, open Settings, then Language, and turn off Translate Entire Chat.

## Where is the cache, and how do I clear it?

The cache is kept on your device. Open Settings, then Data and Storage, then Storage Usage to see how much space photos, videos, files and other data take; on iPhone and iPad the Chats tab shows which chats use it. You can clear all of it or only what you select. The media stays in the Telegram cloud and can be downloaded again.

## How do I save a video to my phone?

To save a video, press and hold it in the chat and tap Save Video on iPhone and iPad (it appears once the video has downloaded) or Save to gallery on Android. Android puts it in the Telegram folder inside Movies; iPhone adds it to the Photos library. If the chat or message restricts saving, the option is not shown.

## How do I choose the quality when saving a video on iPhone?

On iPhone, open the video and tap the three-dot menu in the viewer, then Save to Gallery. When the video comes in several qualities, the menu lists each one, such as Save in 720p, with its file size, and Nicegram then shows the saving progress. Save Original appears only with Telegram Premium.

## How do I copy someone's user ID?

With Show Profile ID on in Nicegram settings, a person's profile shows a row labelled id with their number. On iPhone and iPad, press and hold that id row and tap Copy.

## How do I find a public group, channel or person?

Tap the search field at the top of the chat list and type the name of the group or channel, or the person's username. Your own chats and contacts come first; public groups, channels and people from all of Telegram appear below them under Global Search.

## How do I see all photos and videos from my chats?

Tap the search field at the top of the chat list and switch to the Media tab to see photos and videos from your chats. For one chat, open it, tap its name at the top and open the Media tab.

## Where are my archived chats, and how do I unarchive one?

Archived chats are in Archived Chats at the top of your chat list; if you don't see it, swipe down on the chat list. To move a chat back, open Archived Chats, swipe left on the chat and tap Unarchive (on Android, swiping left unarchives it by default).

## How do I delete my story?

Open your story, tap its menu button, choose Delete Story on iPhone or Delete on Android, and confirm.

## How do I send a Telegram gift to myself?

Open Settings and tap Send a Gift. You are listed at the top to buy yourself a gift; tap yourself and choose the gift. You can show it on your page or keep it for later.

## How do I choose where links open?

On iPhone, go to Settings, then Privacy and Security, then Open Links in, and pick Telegram to open links inside the app, or Safari or another installed browser. On Android, go to Settings, then Chat Settings, and turn In-App Browser on to open links in the app, or off to use your phone's browser.

## Where is the history of pages I opened in the app?

On iPhone, open any web link in the in-app browser and tap the address bar: pages you opened are under Recently Visited. On Android, go to Settings, then Chat Settings, tap the In-App Browser row and tap View History.

## How do I add a song to my profile?

Play the song (an audio file) in any chat, open the player and tap Add to Profile. The song then shows on your profile, and you can remove it from the same player.

## How do I get calls on only one device?

In the app where you want calls, open Settings, then Devices, and tap the other device in the list. On iPhone turn off Incoming Calls under Accept on This Device; on Android turn off Accept Calls. That device stays signed in but does not take calls.

## How do I set an automatic greeting message?

Open Settings, then Telegram Business, then Greeting Messages, and create a greeting; it is sent automatically to new people who write to you. Away Messages on the same screen reply while you are away.

## Can Nicegram AI write a reply for me?

On iPhone and iPad, press and hold a text message someone sent you and tap Draft a Reply. Nicegram AI writes a reply into your message field; you edit it and send it yourself.

## If I delete my group, is it deleted for everyone?

Only if you choose so. When the owner deletes a group, Nicegram asks whether to delete it just for you or for all members; deleting it for all members removes everyone and all messages. On Android, tick Delete the group for all members in the delete dialog.

## How do I delete an old profile photo?

To delete an old profile photo, open Settings and tap your photo to open it full screen, then swipe to the photo you want to remove. On iPhone and iPad tap Edit, then Delete Photo, and confirm with Remove. On Android tap the three-dot menu, then Delete, and confirm.

## Why did my messages disappear, and how do I turn off auto-delete?

Messages can disappear because of auto-delete: a chat or group can delete messages automatically after a set time. To check or turn it off, open the chat and tap its name. On iPhone tap More, then Adjust Auto-Delete, then Disable; on Android tap the three-dot menu, then Auto-Delete, then Disable.

## How do I turn off slow mode in my group?

To turn off slow mode in a group you manage, open the group, tap its name, tap Edit (the pencil on Android), then Permissions, and move the Slow Mode slider to Off.

## Why do messages show the wrong time?

Nicegram shows message times in your phone's time zone. If the times look wrong, check the time zone in your phone's date and time settings, or let the phone set it automatically.

## How do I delete all messages in a chat?

To delete all messages in a chat at once: on iPhone, open the chat, tap its name, then More, then Clear Messages; on Android, open the chat, tap the three-dot menu, then Clear history. In a private chat you can also delete them for the other person.

## How do I change my channel's link?

To change your channel's link, open the channel, tap its name, then Edit, then Channel Type. A public channel's link is t.me/ followed by a name you choose: at least 5 characters, using a-z, 0-9 and underscores. A private channel uses an invite link instead. You need the right to change the channel's info.

## How do I switch to dark mode?

To switch to dark mode on iPhone, go to Settings, then Appearance, and pick the Night theme; or open Auto-Night Theme and choose System to follow your phone's dark mode. On Android, go to Settings, then Chat Settings, then Auto-Night Mode, and choose System Default, Scheduled or Adaptive, or pick a night theme in Chat Settings.

## How do I hide my online status?

To hide when you are online, go to Settings, then Privacy and Security, then Last Seen (Last Seen & Online on Android), and choose My Contacts or Nobody; you can also add exceptions for specific people. People you hide it from see an approximate time instead, such as recently or within a week, and you see the same for them.

## Why can't I find my contacts on Telegram?

Your phone contacts appear in Nicegram only if they use Telegram and let you find them by their number. To add them, turn on Sync Contacts in Settings, then Privacy and Security (on iPhone, under Data Settings). If a number you know shows as not on Telegram, that person may let only their own contacts find them by number, so they need to save your number first. Without a number, search for their username or ask them for their t.me link.

## How do I remove the WhiteBridge banner at the top of a chat?

WhiteBridge (White Bridge) in Nicegram for iPhone and iPad offers an overview of public information found online about a person. To turn off its banner at the top of a chat with a person, tap the × on the banner's left: the banner does not come back in any chat on that device, until Nicegram is reinstalled.

## What is the level badge next to a name, and how do I raise it?

The level badge next to a name in a profile is Telegram's rating. Telegram calculates it, and Nicegram shows it as Telegram does but does not award or sell it. Tap the level in a profile to see what affects it: gifts bought from Telegram count in full, gifts and posts bought from users and channels count at 20%, and refunds and gifts converted back lower it. Topping up a balance alone does not raise it, and new points are added after a waiting period shown on that screen.

## How do I change the language of the app?

To change the language of the Nicegram interface, open Settings, then Language, and choose a language from the list. It is the same setting as in Telegram, and the list shows the languages Telegram offers. Nicegram's own menus follow the language you choose; where a Nicegram menu has no translation into that language, it is shown in English.

## How do I find Telegram channels and groups?

To find Telegram channels, chats, groups, bots, stickers and Mini Apps, browse Nicegram Hub on the website: <https://nicegram.me/hub>. It lists the top ones by category and language, and opens any of them in Nicegram in one tap.

## What is the magnifying glass next to the tab bar on iPhone?

If a magnifying glass appeared at the right of the bottom tab bar in Nicegram for iPhone, it is the search button of the current tab. Version 2.6.4 removed it; the search field stays at the top of the list.

## What is the Nicegram support e-mail?

Nicegram app support by e-mail: <support@nicegram.me>.

## How do I reach a person at Nicegram support?

For something bought in Nicegram (Account Shop, Telegram Sessions), or an unusual problem nothing else covers, write to a person at Nicegram support in Telegram: @nicegram_support_manager (<https://t.me/nicegram_support_manager>).

## How do I advertise my channel or project on Nicegram?

To promote your channel, group, bot or project to Nicegram's audience, use Nicegram's ad platform: the bot @NiceAdsBot (<https://t.me/NiceAdsBot>) or the website <https://ads.nicegram.me>.

## How do ads in Nicegram work?

Advertisers promote a Telegram channel, group, bot, Mini App or single post through Nicegram Ads: the promotion appears as a row in the chat list of the Nicegram app, among the chats people already read, and a tap opens the advertiser's Telegram link. Campaigns are created and managed in the @NiceAdsBot Telegram bot, or on <https://ads.nicegram.me> after signing in; the Nicegram app is not needed to advertise. The advertiser chooses the languages and countries (one at a time, together, or everyone), sets the budget and is charged per view or per click. A campaign can be paused at any time, and stopping it returns the unspent budget to the advertiser's wallet. No number of views is promised: the targeted audience is a ceiling, and people who already have the chat are skipped. A larger, reserved placement is arranged in a conversation through the contact on that page. Current prices and the minimum budget are on <https://ads.nicegram.me>.

## What is King of the Day?

King of the Day is a daily auction for advertisers: the winning bid gets the first entry in the premium pin at the very top of the Nicegram chat list for one UTC day, shown to the whole audience. The winner sits beside the entries already sold in the pin; nobody is removed. A bid's amount moves into the bidder's auction balance and is held there while the bid stands. The current starting bid and step are on the King of the Day page.

## How do I end my sessions on other devices?

To sign your account out on every other device, open Settings, then Devices, and tap Terminate all other sessions; to end just one, tap it in the list. Only the device in your hand stays signed in. If the account was bought through Telegram Sessions, contact support before ending sessions.

## How do I change my phone number?

On iPhone, open Settings, tap Edit and then Change Number; on Android, open Settings and tap your phone number, then Change Number. Enter the new number: Telegram sends the confirmation code by SMS to that new number. If the new number already has its own Telegram account, the app tells you and the change cannot go ahead.

## Can I turn off the login email?

The app has no option to turn off the login email, only to change it: in Settings, then Privacy and Security, tap Login Email (Email Login on Android), and the window offers Change Email or Cancel.

## Why does the app ask me to pay for the SMS code?

The SMS Fee screen comes from Telegram: Nicegram shows it when Telegram's servers answer the request for a code with a payment requirement. Telegram explains that telecom providers in your country charge it very high prices for SMS and offers a short Telegram Premium subscription to cover the cost.

## How do I log out of Nicegram?

To log out on iPhone or iPad, open Settings, tap Edit at the top, scroll down and tap Log Out. On Android, open Settings, tap the three-dot menu at the top right and choose Log out.

## How do I sign in on a computer with a QR code?

When a computer's Telegram app shows a QR code to sign in, open Nicegram on your phone, go to Settings, then Devices, tap Link Desktop Device and scan the code. Nicegram needs camera access to scan it.

## How do I change my password or email?

Your Telegram password belongs to Telegram, not Nicegram: to change it, open Privacy and Security and tap Two-Step Verification. On that screen you can also change the recovery email or add one; it resets a forgotten password. The login email, where Telegram sends your login codes, is changed in the same section under Login Email (Email Login on Android); that row shows once you have one.

## Why didn't my login code arrive?

The login code is sent to the Telegram account of the phone number you enter. If the code doesn't arrive, check where you request it. A new account can be created only in the official Telegram app, so sign up there. To sign in to an account you already have, the code goes to the other app where that account is already signed in: open it, find the code in the chat with Telegram, and enter it in Nicegram. If you have no other signed-in device, tap “Didn't get the code?” and choose to get it by SMS if that is offered.

## Why does Nicegram say my phone was banned?

If Nicegram says “Your phone was banned.” when you try to log in, Telegram has banned that number. A number can be banned for various reasons, and Nicegram cannot lift the ban: only Telegram can review it: write to <support@telegram.org>. If your account is only limited after spam reports (you can't message people who don't have you as a contact), ask Telegram's @SpamBot to review it.

## What should I do if my account was hacked?

If your account may be compromised (someone got into it or changed your password), first secure your Telegram account from a trusted Telegram app: review your active sessions, end any sessions you don't recognise, and turn on two-step verification. Never send a login code or recovery secret to support.

## How do I delete my account?

To remove an account only from Nicegram on this device, log out of it instead (Log Out in the account's settings): the Telegram account and its chats stay, and logging out ends its Secret Chats. To delete your account, use Telegram's deactivation page: <https://my.telegram.org/auth?to=delete>. Deleting the account permanently removes your messages, contacts and other data, must be confirmed through your Telegram account and cannot be undone. Groups and channels you created stay without a creator (admins keep their rights), and your contacts keep their copies of the messages you sent them. If you sign up again, you start as a new user and do not get your history, contacts or groups back.

## What does "Too many attempts" at sign-in mean?

"Too many attempts, please try again later" when you sign in is Telegram's own limit on sign-in attempts, not a Nicegram error. Wait and try again later. If the message says you deleted and re-created your account too many times, wait a few days before signing up again.

## How do I charge Stars for messages from strangers?

Open Settings, then Privacy and Security, then Messages, choose Charge for Messages and set your price per message in Stars. It applies to people outside your contacts who you haven't messaged first. On iPhone the option shows a lock without Telegram Premium, and it appears only where Telegram offers it.

## How do I stop strangers from contacting me?

Open Settings, then Privacy and Security. There you choose who can see your phone number and find you by it, who can call you, who can add you to groups and who can message you. Anyone you never want to hear from can be added to Blocked Users on the same screen.

## How do I hide when I read messages?

Hide Read Time is under Settings, then Privacy and Security, then Last Seen (Last Seen & Online on Android). The switch shows once you pick My Contacts or Nobody, or add exceptions. With it on, people who don't get your last seen don't get the time you opened their messages, and you don't get theirs. Groups are not affected.

## How do I unblock someone?

To unblock someone, open Settings, then Privacy and Security, then Blocked Users. On iPhone swipe left on the person and tap Unblock; on Android tap the person and choose Unblock.

## Can Nicegram read my messages?

Your Telegram chats, channels, login and ordinary calls go through Telegram's services and the app on your device; messages you publish are stored and processed by Telegram's servers. Nicegram's Terms of Use say Nicegram uses the Telegram API only for technical processing and does not own, control, store or have access to your conversations. When you use AI, translation or transcription features, your request and any chat context you select are processed by Nicegram and/or the provider that feature uses.

## What data does Nicegram collect?

Nicegram's Privacy Policy (<https://nicegram.me/privacy-policy>) says Nicegram collects information you choose to provide, such as your name, e-mail and phone number; information collected automatically, such as usage and device information, cookies, and your location when you share it; and app usage information through third-party analytics: Google Play Services and Firebase, plus Facebook SDK and AppsFlyer on Android. The policy says this analytics information is anonymized and cannot be tied to a specific user. Many of the services you use in Nicegram are provided by Telegram, and Telegram's Privacy Policy (<https://telegram.org/privacy>) covers them.

## Why does Nicegram ask for my contacts, location or call log?

Nicegram asks your permission before syncing your contacts; you can stop syncing or delete synced contacts in Settings > Privacy & Security > Data Settings. When you share your location in a chat or turn on "Make me visible to people nearby", Nicegram uses it to show your location to the people you share it with. On Android, Nicegram may ask for access to your call log so it can verify your account with a phone call instead of a code; it uses this only to confirm that verification call.

## Why does Nicegram ask for camera and microphone access?

On iPhone and iPad, Nicegram asks for camera access so you can take and share photos and videos and make video calls, and for microphone access so you can send voice messages and videos with sound.

## Can I trust someone in a Nicegram chat who offers to help?

Community participants are not automatically Nicegram employees. Never share login codes, two-step passwords, exported account sessions, private keys, recovery material or remote access to your device.

## Where did my NFT stickers or gifts go?

If your NFT stickers or gifts disappeared, you may have been scammed. A common scheme: someone promises NFT gifts or stickers and asks you to export your account session from Nicegram. Only scammers ask for this. Never export your session for anyone. Telegram reviews such cases: write to <support@telegram.org>.

## How do I report spam?

To report spam in Nicegram, the same as in Telegram: in a chat with someone not in your contacts, tap Report Spam in the bar at the top when Nicegram shows it, or tap Block User there and tick Report Spam. In a group or channel, press and hold a message, tap Report and choose Spam. On Android a person's profile also has Report in its three-dot menu, even after you blocked them. Telegram's team reviews every report.

## Is Nicegram free?

Nicegram is free to download. A Nicegram Premium subscription unlocks additional features, including features for business. The price and what it includes are shown in the app and in the store.

## How do I get or turn on Nicegram Premium?

To get or activate Nicegram Premium, open Settings in Nicegram: on iPhone and iPad tap Premium, on Android tap Nicegram Premium. That screen shows the plans and their prices, and you buy the subscription there through the App Store or Google Play. Premium turns on once Nicegram confirms the purchase. Already subscribed, reinstalled Nicegram or moved to a new device? Open the same screen and tap "Restore purchase" while signed in with the Apple ID or Google account that bought it.

## How do I cancel a subscription or ask for a refund?

Nicegram subscriptions bought in the App Store or Google Play follow that store's rules for payment, cancellation and refunds. Cancel a subscription, or change its payment method, in the App Store or Google Play account that processed it; cancelling stops renewal after the last day of the current period and is not automatically a refund. To ask for a refund, write to a person at Nicegram support in Telegram: @nicegram_support_manager (<https://t.me/nicegram_support_manager>). A free trial renews as a paid subscription unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the trial ends.

## Why does my free trial show no active subscription?

If you started a free trial of Nicegram Premium but your profile shows no active subscription: the trial runs in the App Store or Google Play, and your Nicegram profile shows Premium only after Nicegram confirms the purchase. Open the Premium screen and tap "Restore purchase" while signed in with the same Apple ID or Google account that started the trial. A subscription counts for the Nicegram account that confirmed it last.

## How many AI messages does each plan include?

Nicegram AI has no fixed number of messages per plan. Each AI request is paid from your AI Tokens balance: a Premium subscription includes monthly tokens, Premium+ includes more, and anyone can buy a top-up. If the balance runs out, the app says there are not enough AI tokens. Between two requests there is a short pause, longer without Premium. Your balance and the current amounts are shown in the app.

## How do I hide 18+ content?

To hide 18+ content, turn off Show 18+ Content: on iPhone and iPad it is in Settings, then Data and Storage; on Android in Settings, then Chat Settings. The switch appears only when Telegram lets your account change this setting.

## Why can't I see sensitive (18+) or restricted content?

Sensitive (18+) and restricted content: Nicegram follows Telegram's rules and the App Store and Google Play policies. Whether sensitive or restricted channels and content are shown on iPhone, iPad or Android depends on those rules and on your account settings. Nicegram does not open deleted, private or paid content.

## Where is the Nicegram wallet?

Nicegram no longer offers the in-app wallet (balances, sending, swaps, NFTs in the wallet and dApp connections). A sign-in method left over from the wallet is separate and does not mean the wallet still exists.

## Can I still earn ATT points?

Nicegram no longer gives ATT points for scrolling or chatting, and the ATT autopilot no longer runs. The old Scroll-to-Earn and autopilot guides are not current instructions.

## When do I get rewards for my ATT points and NFT stickers?

Rewards for the ATT points and NFT stickers you collected are being calculated now; an update with the details is coming soon in the official Nicegram channel @nicegramapp.

## Can I see deleted messages?

Nicegram has no option to see deleted messages. An iOS option that kept messages deleted by others visible existed only briefly, in January 2024 (version 1.5.3), and was removed in the next update. It never recovered messages deleted before it was turned on.

## Where is Ghost mode?

Nicegram replaced Ghost mode with Preview mode in version 5.15.4 (29 February 2020) to comply with Telegram's API terms of service.

## Does Nicegram have eSIM?

Nicegram has no built-in eSIM or mobile data feature. An early eSIM integration from 2022 was removed from the app in 2024.
